description: N4 bias-field correction with ANTs N4BiasFieldCorrection, run from Neurodesk's ANTs container. Writes the intensity-corrected image on the input grid. In the NeuroVue Neurodesk app the latest ANTs module is on PATH; each run starts ANTs in a nested Apptainer container from CVMFS.

image.description: Image to correct, typically a T1-weighted scan.

block.label: Bias-field correction (ANTs N4, Neurodesk)
block.description: Correct intensity inhomogeneity with ANTs N4.

requirements: ANTs from Neurodesk (N4BiasFieldCorrection on PATH, or via NEURODESK_N4)
neuroflow/launch.description: Runs N4BiasFieldCorrection -d 3 -i <image> -o <outputDir>/corrected.nii.gz through the shared native CLI adapter.

probe.advice: ANTs runs from Neurodesk's CVMFS in a nested Apptainer container. Check that CVMFS is mounted (ls /cvmfs/neurodesk.ardc.edu.au/containers) and that this host allows unprivileged user namespaces.
